nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, or empty if there are no more results in the list.

peerIp.description: The peer IP of the attachment.

peerVlanId.description: The peer vlan ID of the attachment.

interconnectAttachment.description: Optional. The name of the vlan attachment within vrf. This is of the form projects/{project_number}/regions/{region}/interconnectAttachments/{interconnect_attachment}

routerIp.description: The router IP of the attachment.

qosPolicy.description: The QOS policy applied to this VLAN attachment. This value should be preferred to using qos at vrf level.

id.description: Immutable. The identifier of the attachment within vrf.

VolumeSnapshot.description: A snapshot of a volume. Only boot volumes can have snapshots.

name.description: The name of the snapshot.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation time of the snapshot.

enumDescriptions: Snapshot was taken manually by user.
Snapshot was taken automatically as a part of a snapshot schedule.
type.description: Output only. The type of the snapshot which indicates whether it was scheduled or manual/ad-hoc.

storageVolume.description: Output only. The name of the volume which this snapshot belongs to.

id.description: Output only. An identifier for the snapshot, generated by the backend.

RestoreVolumeSnapshotRequest.description: Message for restoring a volume snapshot.

LogicalNetworkInterface.description: Each logical network interface is effectively a network and IP pair.

id.description: An identifier for the `Network`, generated by the backend.

enumDescriptions: Client network, a network peered to a Google Cloud VPC.
Private network, a network local to the Bare Metal Solution environment.

defaultGateway.description: Whether this interface is the default gateway for the instance. Only one interface can be the default gateway for the instance.

ReimageInstanceRequest.description: Message requesting to perform reimage operation on a server.

kmsKeyVersion.description: Optional. Name of the KMS crypto key version used to encrypt the initial passwords. The key has to have ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT purpose. Format is `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{keyring}/cryptoKeys/{key}/cryptoKeyVersions/{version}`.

sshKeys.description: Optional. List of SSH Keys used during reimaging an instance.

osImage.description: Required. The OS image code of the image which will be used in the reimage operation.

Lun.description: A storage volume logical unit number (LUN).

name.description: Output only. The name of the LUN.

storageVolume.description: Display the storage volume for this LUN.

bootLun.description: Display if this LUN is a boot LUN.

sizeGb.description: The size of this LUN, in GiB.

shareable.description: Display if this LUN can be shared between multiple physical servers.

expireTime.description: Output only. Time after which LUN will be fully deleted. It is filled only for LUNs in COOL_OFF state.

enumDescriptions: The LUN is in an unknown state.
The LUN is ready for use.
The LUN has been requested to be deleted.
The LUN is in cool off state. It will be deleted after `expire_time`.
state.description: The state of this storage volume.

multiprotocolType.description: The LUN multiprotocol type ensures the characteristics of the LUN are optimized for each operating system.

id.description: An identifier for the LUN, generated by the backend.

storageType.description: The storage type for this LUN.
enumDescriptions: The storage type for this LUN is unknown.
This storage type for this LUN is SSD.
This storage type for this LUN is HDD.

instances.description: Output only. Instances this Lun is attached to.

availableMachineCount.description: Number of machines than can be created for the given location and instance_type.

name.description: Output only. The name of the instance quota.

gcpService.description: The gcp service of the provisioning quota.

name.description: Output only. The system-generated name of the provisioning config. This follows the UUID format.

statusMessage.description: Optional status messages associated with the FAILED state.

handoverServiceAccount.description: A service account to enable customers to access instance credentials upon handover.

enumDescriptions: ProvisioningConfig is a draft and can be freely modified.
ProvisioningConfig was already submitted and cannot be modified.
ProvisioningConfig was in the provisioning state. Initially this state comes from the work order table in big query when SNOW is used. Later this field can be set by the work order API.
ProvisioningConfig was provisioned, meaning the resources exist.
ProvisioningConfig was validated. A validation tool will be run to set this state.
The request is submitted for provisioning, with error return.

vpcScEnabled.description: If true, VPC SC is enabled for the cluster.

location.description: Optional. Location name of this ProvisioningConfig. It is optional only for Intake UI transition period.

customId.description: Optional. The user-defined identifier of the provisioning config.

cloudConsoleUri.description: Output only. URI to Cloud Console UI view of this provisioning config.

ticketId.description: A generated ticket id to track provisioning request.

email.description: Email provided to send a confirmation with provisioning config to. Deprecated in favour of email field in request messages.

pod.description: Optional. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Instance can be connected to the assets (networks, volumes, nfsshares) allocated in the same pod only.

sizeGb.description: The requested size of each LUN, in GB.

usedIps.description: All used IP addresses in this network.

NetworkUsage.description: Network with all used IP addresses.

name.description: Output only. Template's unique name. The full resource name follows the pattern: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/serverNetworkTemplate/{server_network_template}` Generally, the {server_network_template} follows the syntax of "bond" or "nic".

applicableInstanceTypes.description: Instance types this template is applicable to.

StopInstanceResponse.description: Response message from stopping a server.

name.description: Output only. The name of this SSH key. Currently, the only valid value for the location is "global".

publicKey.description: The public SSH key. This must be in OpenSSH .authorized_keys format.

SSHKey.description: An SSH key, used for authorizing with the interactive serial console feature.

RenameNetworkRequest.description: Message requesting rename of a server.

newNetworkId.description: Required. The new `id` of the network.

AllowedClient.description: Represents an 'access point' for the share.

shareIp.description: Output only. The IP address of the share on this network. Assigned automatically during provisioning based on the network's services_cidr.

noRootSquash.description: Disable root squashing, which is a feature of NFS. Root squash is a special mapping of the remote superuser (root) identity when using identity authentication.

allowedClientsCidr.description: The subnet of IP addresses permitted to access the share.

nfsPath.description: Output only. The path to access NFS, in format shareIP:/InstanceID InstanceID is the generated ID instead of customer provided name. example like "10.0.0.0:/g123456789-nfs001"

network.description: The network the access point sits on.

allowDev.description: Allow dev flag. Which controls whether to allow creation of devices.

enumDescriptions: NFS share can be mount with read-only permissions.
NFS share can be mount with read-write permissions.

id.description: Output only. An identifier for the `Instance`, generated by the backend.

luns.description: Immutable. List of LUNs associated with this server.

networks.description: Output only. List of networks associated with this server.

kmsKeyVersion.description: Optional. Name of the KMS crypto key version used to encrypt the initial passwords. The key has to have ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT purpose. Format is `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{keyring}/cryptoKeys/{key}/cryptoKeyVersions/{version}`.

enumDescriptions: The workload profile is in an unknown state.
workloadProfile.description: The workload profile for the instance.

createTime.description: Output only. Create a time stamp.

sshKeys.description: Optional. List of SSH Keys used during instance provisioning.

interactiveSerialConsoleEnabled.description: Output only. True if the interactive serial console feature is enabled for the instance, false otherwise. The default value is false.

logicalInterfaces.description: List of logical interfaces for the instance. The number of logical interfaces will be the same as number of hardware bond/nic on the chosen network template. For the non-multivlan configurations (for eg, existing servers) that use existing default network template (bondaa-bondaa), both the Instance.networks field and the Instance.logical_interfaces fields will be filled to ensure backward compatibility. For the others, only Instance.logical_interfaces will be filled.

enumDescriptions: The server is in an unknown state.
state.description: Output only. The state of the server.

hyperthreadingEnabled.description: True if you enable hyperthreading for the server, otherwise false. The default value is false.

name.description: Immutable. The resource name of this `Instance`. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/instances/{instance}`

updateTime.description: Output only. Update a time stamp.

volumes.description: Input only. List of Volumes to attach to this Instance on creation. This field won't be populated in Get/List responses.

firmwareVersion.description: Output only. The firmware version for the instance.

osImage.description: The OS image currently installed on the server.

networkTemplate.description: Instance network template name. For eg, bondaa-bondaa, bondab-nic, etc. Generally, the template name follows the syntax of "bond" or "nic".

pod.description: Immutable. Pod name. Pod is an independent part of infrastructure. Instance can only be connected to the assets (networks, volumes) allocated in the same pod.

loginInfo.description: Output only. Text field about info for logging in.

DisableHyperthreadingRequest.description: Message requesting to perform disable hyperthreading operation on a server.

required.description: If true, interface must have network connected.

name.description: Interface name. This is not a globally unique identifier. Name is unique only inside the ServerNetworkTemplate. This is of syntax or and forms part of the network template name.
